'''Furufu (Old Furufu) Shrine''' (ふるふじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}, {{ill|Izumi, Osaka|Q696412|qid=Q696412}}. It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=former shrine rank}} it was classified as a village shrine.

=== Enshrined Deity ===
* {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto|qid=Q272993}}

=== History ===
Although it is an ancient shrine listed in the Engishiki, the exact date of its founding and the originally enshrined deity are unknown. The {{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}} records: “On the 7th day of the 5th month of Jōgan 1 (859), mizunoe-inu, the Furufu Deity of Izumi Province was listed among the government shrines. On the 13th day of the 8th month of the same year, hinoe-saru, the unranked Furufu Deity of Izumi Province was granted the Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade.”

During the Edo period it was also called “Gozu Tennō Shrine,” and in the 5th year of Meiji (1872) it was ranked as a village shrine. On June 23, Taishō 4 (1915), it was merged into {{ill|Shinodanomori Kuzunoha Inari Shrine|Q11386029|qid=Q11386029}} in Kuzunoha-chō, but the following year it was re-enshrined at its original shrine buildings.

=== Auxiliary Shrines ===
* Wakamiya Shrine “White Fox Fossil” (enshrined deity: {{ill|Kuzunoha|Q1651785|qid=Q1651785|lt=Princess Kuzunoha}})
*: It is said to be a stone into which a {{ill|White Tiger (mythology)|Q1072455|qid=Q1072455}} transformed (or hid) in order to escape from a hunter. Originally this stone was located along the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Oguri Kaidō}} ({{ill|Kumano Kaidō|Q11568976|qid=Q11568976}}), but in 1947 (Shōwa 22) it was enshrined at Furufu Shrine.<ref>[http://www.buccyake-kojiki.com/archives/1064898822.html Furufu Shrine, Oi, Izumi City, Osaka Prefecture – Shrines and the Kojiki] Accessed June 3, 2018</ref>

=== Access ===
* 6-minute walk (about 500 m south) from {{ill|Kita-Shinoda Station|Q856975|qid=Q856975}} on the JR {{ill|Hanwa Line|Q1154800|qid=Q1154800}}
